Row.Text: Shijin

A Great Person with one charge. Can only be trained in Settlements with a [icon:CITY_RURAL] Jinja (Land) or Jinja (Sea), and the specific Shijin received is random. Each Shijin can only be received once. Cost increases per Shijin trained.
Nakayama Tadachika
Activate on the Palace to add +3 [icon:YIELD_DIPLOMACY] Influence to the building.
Murasaki Shikibu
Activate on a Building or Wonder with a Great Work Slot to receive The Tale of Genji, which grants +2 [icon:YIELD_CULTURE] Culture.
Lady Sarashina
Activate on a Building with a Great Work Slot to receive +1 [icon:YIELD_CULTURE] Culture to this settlement for each slotted Great Work.
Sei Shonagon
Activate on a Building or Wonder with a Great Work Slot to receive The Pillow Book, which grants +2 [icon:YIELD_HAPPINESS] Happiness.
Izumi Shikibu
Activate on an Altar to add +3 [icon:YIELD_CULTURE] Culture to the building.
Michitsuna's Mother
Activate on a Jinja to add +2 [icon:YIELD_HAPPINESS] Happiness to all Jinja in this Settlement.
Oshikochi no Mitsune
Activate on a [icon:YIELD_CULTURE] Culture building to grant +2 [icon:YIELD_CULTURE] Culture to all [icon:YIELD_CULTURE] Culture buildings in this Settlement.
Ki no Tomonori
Activate on the Palace to add +3 [icon:YIELD_HAPPINESS] Happiness to the building.
Ki no Tsurayuki
Activate on a Building with a Great Work Slot to grant +1 Slot to all Buildings in this Settlement with a Great Work slot.
Mibu no Tadamine
Activate on a [icon:YIELD_CULTURE] Culture building in a City. Its Specialists grant +1 [icon:YIELD_CULTURE] Culture.
